title: Deleted
body: It’s missing a lot of airlines and the info on the ones it does have is wrong, incomplete, or outdated.

title: Appy no worky
body: Wanted to see how good this worked so I paid for the pro version to see the live seatmaps. It worked ok for 1 day now and now nothing. Won’t load the seats at all. Not as advertised at all. Will be attempting to get my $50 back from Apple.

title: Useless
body: Swing and a miss? You give me seat view without showing window alignment and other basic info i can get for free on websites. Sure an app would be convenient but you gotta give us more. To have a pro version that gives us simple basic info we get free online is insane.

title: Value not there
body: The “Live” seat map always showed not available. if it linked to airline apps or apps like Tripit it could eliminate cross-referencing and manual entry.

title: Worthless
body: I downloaded this, tried it once, found it was horrible, and deleted it. It showed several rows of first class 2X2 seats on Southwest. Seriously? There are no first class seats on Southwest. The descriptions of ty he Southwest seats day that SW has open seating, while SW has had reserved seats for almost a year. The maps don't even show the exit rows! The graphics are cartoony and childish. It's a worthless app.
